contract: Send a streaming request interrupted before headers and an independent non-streaming request that completes normally. Retry the first request, cancel the second, then retry the first once more.
Cancel one unknown key. Retry a different unknown key, then cancel the first unknown key again. Do not create any requests.

Send a stream interrupted before headers, an independent non-streaming request without interruption, and a third independent stream interrupted after its first chunk. Retry the third request, cancel the first, and retry the second.

Start a non-streaming request that completes normally. Retry it and then cancel it. Only after those actions, start a second independent uninterrupted streaming request; cancel that stream and retry the second request.

Starte eine Streaming-Anfrage und unterbrich sie vor den Headern. Brich diese Anfrage ab; versuche dieselbe danach erneut. Führe anschließend cancel für einen anderen, unbekannten Schlüssel aus. Versuche schließlich die ursprüngliche Anfrage noch einmal.
I have an earlier request. For its next action I have not decided between retry and cancel; do not choose for me.
Change the router configuration, then send one non-streaming request without interruption.
Create four independent, uninterrupted non-streaming requests. Then retry a never-used key that is different from all four request keys.
